<infobox theme="Other-Media">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Publication information</header>
        <data source="host"><label>Host</label></data>
        <data source="location"><label>Location</label></data>
        <data source="start date"><label>Start date</label></data>
        <data source="end date"><label>End date</label></data>
        <data source="type"><label>Type</label></data>	
        <data source="series"><label>Series</label></data>
        <data source="preceded by"><label>Preceded by</label></data>
        <data source="followed by"><label>Followed by</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:RealEvent|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

==Usage instructions==
Copy and paste the following code into the top of the article, filling the appropriate fields. If a field is unknown, or does not apply, simply delete it.
<pre><nowiki>
{{RealEvent
|image=
|name=
|host=
|location=
|start date=
|end date=
|location=
|type=
|series=
|preceded by=
|followed by=
}}
</nowiki></pre></noinclude>
